new-birth.title: Obochari Mosabeté
new-birth.summary: Chingaire eretera Yesu korete obochari bwa omoteo n'eya Omoya na etaramu ya abachamari b'amasomo ga Abatume mu Ebikorania.

0.title: Obochari obwa riaberete nigo obwanyarirwe
0.explanation: Nikodemo agokaga Yesu okororana nka morimu morure, ariko Yesu omweirete obuya ng'ode: omonto oyio atakoborocha kure bia Obotoro bwa Nyasae endire akoborotie obochari bundi, kana obochari obwa riaberete. Ebiasire, oboreng'ania, ekoregwa engere yaamanyire, n'oboriche Yesu akora, tibindi bieta obochari oborwa Nyasae. Ogo nigo gochia obokora obwondoni obw'ogosorete Nikodemo: ng'ano omonto akoborotie gokorana bundi? Yesu amenyeta ekeng'esoika ry'ekeboria, agosochoria engere yogwate kandi eyatira Omoya bwa Nyasae.
0.hook: Yesu agosochoria obochari bundi bwanyarirwe okoborocha kure bia obotoro. Yosabiye eboria riagokobwa riakora neri omondo n'Omoya.

1.title: Omoteo n'Omoya
1.explanation: Yesu ageteete Nikodemo ng'okoborocha kure bia obotoro bwa Nyasae etagete obochari bwa omoteo n'Omoya. Enkaini y'ekenyeni yamanyire amagendi omoteo, abaruore b'Abatume mbaigutia obosobo, Eigesani erata omoteo ni Ekemio n'erekimanwa ring'a Yesu, n'Omoya bo koretereria okoborora Omoya Omoseri (Holy Ghost), kimwe n'ebia Acts 2:38 ebitoreitete omoteo n'Omoya. Kio ni okorwa robwokania egwate n'ebia ekonywa amanya, endire erandwete amageni John 3:5 tarabatere etikoboi ng'okora neri.
1.hook: Yesu agusariete obochari bwa omoteo n'Omoya bwanyarirwe okoborocha obotoro. Acts 2 ekorania abaruore be abate obochari buno bagenda gose.

2.title: Eteramu ya abatume
2.explanation: Abandu b'egetinga barumire Petero akabarika Yesu ni Omwami n'omokristu. Gokobouka, bagosaba ng'akora korere. Petero amagete kobwatire ogosonyera egeseko, Ebatiso n'erina rya Yesu na kwandika engemusani ereta Ogosono Omoya Omoseri (Holy Ghost). Abari Abatume Eigesani bagachania nogotetia Yesu aseigia obochari bwa omoteo n'Omoya buorie John 3. Okamareria korigereria, kioria ebikorania egeseko n'engemusani, gochonya John agokora eboria obochari bundi.
2.hook: Petero agusariete gokoboka n'ebatiso, engemusani n'Omoseri. Enkaini yebere ekorania biae, endire bahasa emaliye ogochia abagokorania.

3.title: Engemusani egenderete ire
3.explanation: Petero agatuma engemusani ni yagokwa barogochia, kwabone bobere, na abandu be bianchi, ogongereria bone abarikwa Nyasae. Ekeboria kiria tiriko abandu b'egetinga gokora emaliye yagorania Jerusalem. Egento eng'ana korigereria ebositani naga amiango ebio Nyasae abarikwa. Engemusani inarigereria abari Nyasae abarikwa korete, endire Ebitorania n'osiborie obochari bwo.
3.hook: Engemusani ngonchari biebie, abebere, n'abose abarikwa Nyasae. Acts 8 ekerania ebatiso n'engemusani binateikire ise bagotimana eme.

4.title: Omoteo n'Omoya binamerania
4.explanation: Abasamariani barorerete ebigokorania Nyasae, barabatisiwa ekerina rya Yesu, ariko Luka areta Omoya Omoseri (Holy Ghost) atakorete. Petero na Yohane bateka, bagosomera abandu, bagoborera omwoyo. Abari Abatume Eigesani bagusariete engesoika y'okorania engemusani ebitari basa, Obotiani grew ebatiso n'ogochia Omoya. Ebibania biria ntigekora ng'ondi obochari boranwa ebino, ariko begetia abaruore babere beregea Omoya avamate abate ebatisiwa.
4.hook: Abasamariani barabatisiwa ariko Omoya borara. Titus egecha omoteo n'engemusani bagokorana onderia embabazi ya Nyasae.

5.title: Entiere n'eng'ochania
5.explanation: Paulo areta koborera ring'a ingurani kobwo rerere, obokoboria bwembabazi ya Nyasae, korete eng'otakera egi bacheria n'obochani bw'Omoya Omoseri (Holy Ghost). Omwoyo ogechoriwe bo Yesu Kristo. Engesoika nigo engwate ya Nyasae ekorania obochari bundi. Abari Abatume bagoborera obochari bwa omoteo n'Omoya, ebibesera biboiria n'ekere abamuchete obotoki bogeire bwembabazi.
5.hook: Paulo agoborera eng'otakera n'obochani bw'Omoya Omoseri (Holy Ghost) ataobwo itinge rirererie ebiasire. Obochani obw'oborinda nibwo bugotanganiwa emiatuko: ogosonyera.

repentance.title: Okobokera
repentance.summary: Rondera okobokera gose nigo ogotebokereria Nyasae, taria kworwa oreta; nogotwikwa korendete Nyasae getai.

0.title: Yeso anyoreerete okobokera nigo obwatekire
0.explanation: Yeso abwatekire ekori yaye eng'ania aboria abamanyete ng'aki ne mang'ana ago: oburangwete bwase bokagereire, obokoramu bwa Nyasae bware kareita, na abandu barekererie gokobokera kandi begonsie emang'ana ma ebirori. Okobokera na kweresia Nyasae kosinende tondubire, ebia nobwate buna gotwagiterwa. Okobokera nigo ogotindera oreta ebia okomonwa na ebiasinende gose ochiere gotebokereria Nyasae nomsike. Ebirori nigo birachera ekeng'ana kiamosi ekikong'ana kerandi Nyasae, enkaata nigo birora ching'ana chi abakoreri.
0.hook: Yeso abwatekire ebirori by'Obokoramu na kweresia Nyasae ekong'ana nigo abwatekire gotaboka Okobokera. Luka 13 igokwana okobokera ni ching'ana chisimo, taria gotabwa; nogokobokera kisimi.

1.title: Okobokera nichiane gose ogotegwa
1.explanation: Yeso anyarerie aberia kerandi nigo abaisaniire ebiragano ebiriria, abandu abitaka embori y'enchwe mong'ina are. Asiyorie egento kemwensi yane korwa abamanyete chibesa bonene. Yeso apinyete kobosora obwati obwo, akorire abantwane barekererie gokobokera. Okobokera sibitirere gotosa abanto abategete suba gose gotebenikora enyao n'ekio; nigo ogotimwa eng'ania yokwoboisire mesa ya Nyasae erambe omonto. Ichi enkaata igochengia abanto gotebekanie sabu y'obwate, okwanyi chiomegeta gokobokera Nyasae.
1.hook: Yeso anyarerie abanto barekererie gokobokera. Ekerandi keyio, nyaririe ekongi ki obokoramu bwechonchi otabokire ekome Yesu ayaririe gotaboka omwanchi.

2.title: Eriyo ching'ana chi okobokera
2.explanation: Yeso obwong'ina kwe bochete, anyorera abaisaniire abamanyete Kristo obwatekire kogotimwa no gosire hamwe nere na gokorira okobokera na rongora ki ebiasinende ebigendererwe echoni Kristu yamanyete, ebia asime osu mwong'ina weri. Okobokera nigo oboko bw'ekebirori kimage Yesu osi. Si ching'ana chisimo gose omwando ogotwikirwa, nego kobocha ekero, ningarora abandu barekererie gotaboka Kristo bwechonchi, oboko bunge Petero kwa Pentecosti.
2.hook: Yeso amae enyamwoyo bw'obokoramu na rongora y'echoni Kristo yaya imitete ekeronde. Ebikorio by'Abaitabire by'Ababereire bikwomba ching'ana chi Petero.

3.title: Gochokera ekeng'ana kobokorera
3.explanation: Enyama, Petero akonyeria abaisaniire bano baroreire ng'aki omonto Kristo obiire, na osinge korendeire gotaboka Roma. Ekong'ana ekwatogere Petero nikwo: okobokera, ogosira ekong'ana eki Kristo ne Nyasae, nobwate okonyeria eng'ania uye, ne Gusii Ghost (Holy Ghost) abosete. Okobokera nibwo bwate bonene bwarekorania oreta obwa Kristo, kibwate obwate okonyeria emenyo, ogosira enyakabiasinende ching'ana. Sio gochiriria gokobokera gotigania ichore, kennyaririe okobokera nigo ogoteresia bwabere bwaya oreta ya gariete Petero ekerandi gero.
3.hook: Petero nyere ekong'ana ekome: okobokera. Paulo anyoretea gotaboka okobokera kokwana gotandikana nekanywabe kandiki.

4.title: Obokobokera bw'Nyasae botoma gwoko
4.explanation: Paulo atwandikire obokobokera bw'Nyasae botoma gorote egento y'ekebughano. Obokobokera bw'Nyasae nikwo gomanyete omotegete ekong'ana, aobokobokera obochia gose ogwatereza bwate bw'egento gusa. Ekerorne nigo okomonwa buka omonto amachoka ogoteboka Nyasae chisimo, notasagwa gotunya ekeng'ana ki asomeki. Ekerorne kemioria omwanchi Paulo amaroranie abakorinto, botsingwu ya bochi nobwate omanyago ki okebere okobokera. Emegeti y'okobokera kiorererete ago gotuma oreta gochira ekeng'ani koige kona, egento gotere.
4.hook: Obokobokera bw'Nyasae botoma okobokera bw'obosaki bokonyeri obochi. Egento ekiriori gokonya ekong'ana obuomo: kwonyora Gusii Ghost.

receiving-the-holy-ghost.title: Kurora Ekebori Egira Holy Ghost (Omoya Omoseri)
receiving-the-holy-ghost.summary: Bora omorongo, korororia, na kukobora kw'Ekebori Egira Holy Ghost.

0.title: Omorongo
0.explanation: Kubw'ekinyora ekya Joel, Nyasae agororerete korosa Omoya omoseria kogosigiriria ogo abanto bose: abaiseke, abasacha, abaiseke abato, abasacha abato, na abarundi. Omorongo ogo ogaseka oborara obose obw'obwobu, obotinga, na eng'endero y'abaisi. Petero kabere akogotora ekinyora ekya Joel goseengera obotumwa obori kwe Pentecost. Ogo gogokora ng'ogotwaba nigo ekebori eretwe Nyasae roya nkera, tibogorane ekorabw'omoindi we muntu chinkoba k'oborindori bwa omwoyo.
0.hook: Joel agororerete ekero ekebori egororania Omoya wa Nyasae omochiere obororera abanto bose. Yesu abwanchani, atarama omwoyo ogotwaba, obuya obobwere bwe barende asabira cheni; abere ekerindeire mo.

1.title: Nakorwana n'omoigo bwanyamwene
1.explanation: Yesu agororerete 'Onyaiteria omwanyi', Omoya wa ringeria, ogotigana n'abaisekeno, abere abateitera, 'Ndekereria kwenyu.' Ekinyora ekio kimanyora oborya ogotua gosekerorwamo kw'ebesa bw'ekebori na ring'ana enka Yesu are n'abarwanyi. Ekenyaiti Egonabere (Apostolic Oneness) kiigwa Omoya ogo Osaka wa Nyasae omwene, osiachiria n'abaisekeno, tibori Nyasae ororire ing'ina. Ogokwenda kwegeria ekerindeire 'ogwomwonyo endi', gosekerigania chomu ombuchani bw'ekibwasese chisari emetemosi.
1.hook: Yesu agororerete Onyaiteria omwanyi gokomenyera n'abanto bose. Ebikorwa bia Acts 2 buetabera ichiekire okorworo okwo gochamokire.

2.title: Omorongo ogokorirwe
2.explanation: Kwe Pentecost abaiseke bose bekerorani Omoya Omoseri, baranga okomakora n'ebirango languages endi Omoya n'ogotigania. Nyasae niwe agoteira ekebori ogo, ebirango ogokobokera n'obwamosi bw'ekoborania. Petero abwanchania okobokania ekinyora ekya Joel na koitimira kwe Yesu kweboga. Ekerindeire Egonabere kiwona ekeri ekia mbere echeni ebirango languages chiberete omwoyo chingoborania bwambere. Ekibwati kiandikire obwati kikoiwe abari omogwabo; ebisamo ebindi bibesiete gokora ebirira obwanto bw'ekoborania.
2.hook: Kwe Pentecost borota omwoyo baranga ekirango ch'Omoya. Petero akobwanchania engeri ogo omwoyo gotigania enka abari ebwachumba ching'a bonyene.

3.title: Omorongo ogotoigirwe abanto baryo Nyasae areta
3.explanation: Petero oteranania omorongo ogo n'oboyaya gosekerera na kubatizwa mo erina ria Yesu. Onyora enka omorongo ogotigania abanto barye Nyasae areta, n'abana n'abari omochiere. Makondere egento ekia ogo omoya tibogukomirira abari ebwachumba bonyene. Chigenda Nyasae nigo atinga, tiboyaya gosekereria be goturisa orwero ch'omuntu koigwa.
3.hook: Petero aretereria omorongo kwe abanto baryo Nyasae areta. Acts 10 kiwona omorongo ogosiokera abachera b'abaganda n'eng'endero abayisiraeli bogotiakira.

4.title: Abachera b'abagira bagokoborerwa
4.explanation: Petero ayanchania kwe nyumba ya Cornelius, Omoya Omogoseri okwamereria abachera b'abanyora. Abayisiraeli ba Nyasae bamenyera omorongo ogo nigo borengera gotingwa ebirango languages na kozorera Nyasae. Ogo n'ogokora nigo gotuya omochiere omogoseri bwambere okorire omoyaya gosekereria. Ekirango tibori gosekereria chibwomosetie; Luka andike ch'ogotura korete abato n'eng'endero baborire ogo okorire.
4.hook: Obokoborerwa bw'abachera bamenyeriwe gotingana ekirango abaiseke babwanchania. Acts 19 kiwona Paulo abasa abanto ba Efeso kobaboneire Omoya Omoseri.

5.title: Abaiseke babasani bagokoborerwa
5.explanation: Paulo abwanchania abaiseke ba Efeso kobaboneire Omoya Omoseri kwe boigire. Akobwanchania Yesu, ababatiza mo erina Ria Yesu, akaorosa maboko, Omoya Omogoseri okwamereria; babangira n'ebirango languages na Gotumira ebwa Nyasae. Ekerindeire Egonabere kiwona ekenyianyia ong'aini ko kwoga Omoya n'egento egia echenda, tibokobatiiria boigwe ibande. Luka oandikire obwanchania obw'ebirango na Gotumira, tibwacho abwanchania kimwe-chie.
5.hook: Abaiseke ba Efeso bagometania Omoya Omoseri n'eng'endero ebirango. Omonyondo omwambiri ogokombeire ekirango kiakora ekowona mo Acts.

tongues-as-initial-sign.title: Ebitabu ndirikana abaya esiki isindi ya Ekorindo
tongues-as-initial-sign.summary: Ogosete eng’ana ekoranga buya bw’okwonyorwa Ebitabu mubanduku ya Ebikorania, na eng’ana ekoranga Erang’ani oria etorete Ekorindo.

0.title: Oguoti bose babwannani Esikukumano Esia
0.explanation: Luka anyora ng’o bose abamanyirie Esikukumano Eng’aini Eresi ya Pentekosti bagokorania ebirimi ebindi, Korwa Esikukumano erageribo. Ebirimi tibiasarokiwe gose; bieri etaro eretabwanani ko Luka areria. Enyigisho ya Apostolic Oneness egoka ebirimi bori oirende enyaroka ekwaboria, iboirete go kubweya Pentekosti, Essakira ria Kornelio, na Eefeso. Endaghwa egokora okuhiria Pentekosti, ekenywe erenderio ki terekero yaiborianywe bugeni muma Egikorania, nigo getsya enyigisho eso. Ekero eya bori erenyereria Pentekosti, nago ekiani gia enyigisho esa Enyigisho ya Buri iangi ebikwa ndombi, egokora mo terekero ego onke Egikorania.
0.hook: Pentekosti, bose abamanyirie Esikukumano bagokorana ebirimi ebindi. Petero orekereria ererania ekwaboria egokorani kigendi okwomonyo, ogokwa ng’aniya eng’ana ekororwa eyarageranwa eyomone na eyomorani.

1.title: Eyomonwa na eyobwate
1.explanation: Petero orerie ng’o Yesu ogokwata magendo ya akaba Esikukumano ogokwa ekomanya ekomonyi na ekobwata. Pentekosti nogwe ebwate bori aborigerani, nigo esio see esokominwa gose see akwe irengi y’embuya etekerani. Ebikorania 2:4 egokora ebirimi bori ekonyo ekobwate pakati ogokuhiara Esikukumano. Enyigisho ya Apostolic Oneness enyora ekikio igokora ebirimi esi kiihe kia endaghwa ekwe Gokorania. Nere, Ebikorania 2:33 egote eererie ng’o mwanchi oyangi abwate erena ebirimi; ekicho gikwanire genye genyora ebio ebindi.
1.hook: Petero ogokera Esikukumano eya bwate bo obokorania. Ebikorania 10 niyu ogokora eng’ana y’abaya bagokomonya go Gentile bagokoranie ebiero bingi.

2.title: Echia enyora
2.explanation: Piero akeria Kornelio na abagaki be, Esikukumano ekogoka ho Gentiles. Abayuda bagokora go bagosikiriana Esikukumano egokorania go ebirimi, bagokomina Nyasae. Luka oreta ebio ekemona ekokorania abaya abari nayo, bogo enyora. Enyigisho ya Apostolic Oneness eyoguha nigo enyora ekero echo esari ekware ka Pentekosti. Enyora esio egokorera eka Nyasae agokora Esikukumano enyamwe okobatismiwa, naguo ebwe nigo ogokorania abwayaki, Luka egote abwate ogokomeria ebirwanani.
2.hook: Abayuda bagosikirana Gentiles bagokoranie Esikukumano nigo bagomonyo bagokorana ebirimi. Petero kwemosa ogokorera ekemona eretani na Pentekosti.

3.title: Ebiekari ebio byoako kio noongwana
3.explanation: Petero ogiti erenyereria ekokorerwa Esikukumano eKornelio esio, "endiya na ingo emogo". Ogokera ng’o Nyasae agorete ebieria biokwabera na tabeire ng’onya. Ekemona ekio ekemona Gentile ebikorania na Pentekosti, engo echio nigo ichio ogokwa ekemona bori. Enyora esio ekokoha ebyerania bori, Petero nigo ogokora esa ekarora Nyasae agokokwa Gentiles tayao ekirigo enge eng’ania ebesa ebieno, esio ekewandika ebosimi ebayo.
3.hook: Petero oriera Gentiles bagokoranie ebieria biori endiya na ingo. Ebikorania 19 egokera ebwate ekemona ekiwa esio bori abaya abaya erena Kristo ekio.

4.title: Ekemona ekiwi enderi
4.explanation: Paulo agokwara abaya Eefeso amagoko, Esikukumano ogoka ho, bagokorana ebirimi bagokomina ebisangio. Luka agokera ebirimi enderi ekemona ekiwa Esikukumano, kisiombeka Eerusalemu na Kesaria. Enyigisho ya Apostolic Oneness eyoguha nigo enyakora ebirimi bori ekemona ekiwa. Endaghwa eyoka ogokwakwa enyorani ekemona, ogokora na ebisangio; enyigisho yugure emenya ng'o ebirimi bireka ebimenya eng'aniya ebisangio.
4.hook: Abaya Eefeso bagokoraninga ebirimi ogokwa Esikukumano egoka ho. Eng’aniyo ekeriko eng’aniyo ekei, ekio ekorania eng’aniya ogokwa Paulo erigia ebirimi engo enyora Erangi ya abaya ekorania Igoro.

5.title: Ebirimi ebwate moise bori oborwa
5.explanation: Paulo omonya, "Bose bagokorania ebirimi?" Ebikorania ekeng’aniyo eng’aniyo eya ebwerani ebirimo ebirimi engo Ebisangio ebwarete moise. Enyigisho ya Apostolic Oneness enyora ebirimi esio ekigoro ogokwa emanyirere Esikukumano mogokwa Egikorania. Eng’aniyo eso egokora eka enyorani ekeng’aniyo ese, naguo Paulo agote akorera ebio. Ekioria giromeria gotinda Ekorania 12 na Egikorania, ti gukang’ania ebirimo esio.
5.hook: Ekorania ekeng'aniyo eng'aniyo ebisangio ebya abaya ekerende moise, tiborire gotindi gose okobwata Esikukumano encho Egikorania. Enyorete, goodhamba egiogokwa nobwanyigue gokerana Okobera, Kwobwata, n’Obokorwa kwa Kristo.
